title: Counterexamples to Atom Positivity for Flagged LLT Polynomials
description: A research note by Yoncheng Hu, Zihao Huang, and Yue Zhou gives a family of counterexamples to the Demazure-atom positivity conjecture for ordinary flagged LLT polynomials with standard compatible permutations, together with an F-kappa-positivity counterexample. A full paper will be released soon.
